environment.configuration_boundary: Canonical ordinary three-message mode reported by owner. Named event/SUMMARY receipts independently checked for finite budgets, content TTFT, terminal state and usage; large private REQUEST prefixes are not rescanned by this publication.

HTTP.scope: Only these exact selected client request intervals; not service load, all-client concurrency or a sustained 12-16 claim.

cost.scope: Recorded wall windows include source/contract work, model waits, review, owner corrections, and coordination; earlier qualification and exclusive active labor were not fully recorded. Earlier independent units are separately costed.
cost.owner_preparation_error: Delivery script parse failed before execution/write; one comma corrected without source, Java or expectation change. Not a model defect.

input.guidance: Owner previous scoped design and full record shapes, invariants, exact method signatures and guards supplied. This is guided implementation, not autonomous architecture or FP arithmetic inference.

adoption.implementation: One complete decoded 5270-byte API class adopted byte for byte, including EOL/EOF; independently found once in model JSON and equal to selected source. Owner Java changes zero; no correction request.
adoption.counter: Only generic checks already explicit in the owner contract retained as reminders. Canonical representation of unknown bits was wrongly treated as actual zero; a condition mask was confused with exception priority. No new oracle or code.
adoption.oracle: Owner six-unit acceptance frozen before any answer reading. Actual owner Test source written after implementation reading against that earlier contract; not blind Test code or model oracle.

validation.scope: Pure carrier validation and explicit unknown/normal/stop/input contracts only; no floating-point arithmetic, actual control-state capture, CPU/OS delivery or full caller binding.

formal.original_software_cutoff: Ready for the sole formal writer; pending/source/model records preserved unchanged.
formal.thin_wrapper_boundary: Only a new owner thin JUnit wrapper verifies the same existing finite units; one selected pass is not an additional scenario or model-generated Test.
